{{Quote|I was sent by Ralia Reevens, Nym's Quarter...''"<br />"''...Master, yes yes, I know her.|A spacer and [[Dak Vox]]|<ref name="SWG:IWIA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|I Want It All|Lok}}</ref>}}
'''Ralia Reeven''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] member of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] who lived on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I've come to ask about a requisition for supplies.''"<br />"''Well, that's what a Quartermaster is for, after all. But I'm afriad that I don't have much on-hand. What do you need?|A spacer and Ralia Reeven|<ref name="SWG:GtP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Gimme the Prize|Lok}}</ref>}}
Ralia Reeven was a member of the [[Reeven Clan]],<ref name="SWG:SM" /> a Rodian clan allied with [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] and his [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] since before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="SC">''[[Star Wars: Starfighter: Crossbones]]''</ref> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she was also a member of the Lok Revenants, working as [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] for Nym and the Revenants in [[Nym's Stronghold]]. During this time, she had to deal with recurrent supply shortage.<ref name="SWG:GtP" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the water treatment facility that supplied the city of Nym's Stronghold in drinkable [[Water/Legends|water]] got broken and was unable to correctly filtrate sulfur from water. Unfortunately, the water treatment [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Phor Cl-lan]] missed the parts required to repair the filtration system.<ref name="SWG:PIP" /> A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for Nym and Phor Cl-lan therefore visited Ralia Reeven to request supplies to fix the water filtration facility.<ref name="SWG:GtP" /> The spacer first asked for cationic chemical coagulant to resupply the mixing chamber of the water treatment system.<ref name="SWG:RtMC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Resupply the Mixing Chamber|Lok}}</ref> Reeven did not possessed cationic chemical coagulant but she was aware that the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Dak Vox]] produced such chemical on [[Mount Chaolt]]. As Vox owed Nym a favor, the smuggler could not refuse to provide chemicals.<ref name="SWG:IWIA" /> Later, the spacer came back, requesting a motor power regulator to repair the flocculation chamber.<ref name="SWG:RtFC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Repair the Flocculation Chamber|Lok}}</ref> However, Ralia Reeven got world that a Lok Revenant agent named [[Rei Reeven]] had been severely injured. She prompted the spacer to rush medical supplies to her clanmate before it was too late. Rei Reeven was stranded in the middle of the [[Great Maze of Lok]] but the spacer successfully found his way and rescued the agent in time.<ref name="SWG:SM" /> Ralia then provided the motor power regulator to the spacer.<ref name="SWG:SaS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Safe and Sound|Lok}}</ref> Eventually, Phor Cl-lan was able to fix the water treatment facility and provide clean water to the city.<ref name="SWG:RwGN">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Return with Good News|Lok}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ralia Reeven was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:PIP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ralia Reeven was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:PIP" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
